subject: Hummingbird PoC: timeline, stakeholders & compliance MAP
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.ai>
To: Ellen Sharp <ellen@hummingbird.ai>, Jamal Ortiz <jamal.ortiz@hummingbird.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-25T15:23:00-07:00
Subject: Hummingbird PoC: timeline, stakeholders & compliance MAP

Hi Ellen / Jamal —

Thanks again for making time today. Quick recap from our conversation and proposed next steps so we have a single place to track ownership:

Pain & goals (what we heard)
- High false-positive rate in customer support triage — target is to reduce hand-offs by 40% within 90 days.
- Need strict data residency and auditable logs for masked PII and redaction.
- Cost predictability: procurement requires a clear estimate of 95th-percentile token spend for pilot sizing.

What Redwood will help with
- Run a 6-week PoC on dedicated capacity with a dedicated VPC and configurable retention controls.
- Provide prefix caching + quantization config to meet latency SLAs.
- Deliver an eval pack and SOC2 evidence map for your security review.

Immediate asks / mutual action items
1) Confirm pilot stakeholders & signatures for MAP (see attached Hummingbird_MAP_v1.xlsx).
2) Procurement: please share your preferred PO/contracting cadence and typical SOW checklist.
3) Compliance: we attached SOC2-evidence-request.pdf — let us know which artifacts you need first (config, logs, or access controls).

Proposed dates (draft)
- Week of 11/8: kickoff + environment access (Hummingbird to provide VPC peering info)
- Week of 11/15: baseline integration + sample traffic
- Week of 11/29: validation & ops runbook handoff
- Week of 12/6: executive summary & decisions (go/no-go)

I'll pull this into a mutual action plan and share a version with owners and exact dates. Can Ellen confirm the procurement timeline (target sign by mid-December?) and who will be the procurement lead? Jamal — is security the correct hook for the SOC2 artifacts or should we loop in someone else?

Attachments: Hummingbird_MAP_v1.xlsx (draft), SOC2-evidence-request.pdf, Redwood_POCTechSpec.pdf

Thanks — happy to hop on a 30-min sync to walkthrough the MAP if helpful.

— Priya
Priya Natarajan | Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
priya@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192
From: Ellen Sharp <ellen@hummingbird.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jamal Ortiz <jamal.ortiz@hummingbird.ai>, procurement@hummingbird.ai
Date: 2026-10-26T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hummingbird PoC: timeline, stakeholders & compliance MAP

Priya — thanks for the clear recap.

Quick answers:
- Procurement timeline: target is to complete procurement review and sign by 2026-12-16. Our procurement lead (CC'd) will need a draft SOW + cost estimate by 2026-11-29 to hit that date.
- Security: Jamal is our primary security reviewer; he will own SOC2 artifact review. He may loop in our InfoSec engineer (Talia) if we need deeper infra artifacts.
- Stakeholders: product (me), security (Jamal), procurement (procurement@hummingbird.ai), and ops (Talia Ops if needed). For exec sign-off, our Head of Customer Success (Maya Lin) will be the final approver.

A couple of asks from our side:
1) Can you provide an itemized estimate broken down by token band (baseline, 95th percentile) + the cost delta for enabling dedicated capacity vs shared hosted? We need this for procurement.
2) For the PoC, we prefer data masking to happen on ingest — can you confirm if Redwood supports token-level redaction in the VPC deployment?

We like the draft dates. If you can update the MAP with owners (internal/external) and the requested cost table, we can circulate internally and confirm the kickoff.

Thanks — Ellen
Ellen Sharp
VP Product, Hummingbird AI
ellen@hummingbird.ai | +1 (650) 555-2233

From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.ai>
To: Ellen Sharp <ellen@hummingbird.ai>, Jamal Ortiz <jamal.ortiz@hummingbird.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>, procurement@hummingbird.ai
Date: 2026-10-29T09:44:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hummingbird PoC: timeline, stakeholders & compliance MAP (updated MAP + cost table)

Ellen / Jamal —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. I’ve updated the MAP and attached: Hummingbird_MAP_v1.xlsx (owners + dates) and a short cost table below. Also attached Redwood_POCTechSpec.pdf for the VPC/redaction details.

Key MAP milestones (owner | target date)
- Kickoff & infra enablement | Hummingbird (network) + Redwood (infra) | 2026-11-08
- Data onboarding (masked samples) | Hummingbird (data eng) | 2026-11-15
- Integration validation (latency & accuracy) | Redwood eng + Hummingbird product | 2026-11-29
- Ops runbook + security evidence handoff | Redwood compliance + Jamal | 2026-12-03
- Exec decision (Maya Lin) | Hummingbird exec | 2026-12-16

Decision process
- Technical validation: integration tests + 2-week telemetry review window (product + ops)
- Security review: Jamal to sign off on SOC2 artifact set (we will deliver requested artifacts by 2026-12-03)
- Procurement: procurement@hummingbird.ai to confirm SOW and issue PO for pilot by 2026-12-16 to enter production runway.

Cost (draft)
- Baseline pilot (shared hosted): estimated 95th-percentile tokens/month = 12M; cost estimate = $16,800/mo
- Dedicated capacity option (recommended for predictable latency): fixed monthly reserved fee + token surcharge = $12,000/mo + $0.0012/token beyond baseline (estimated total = $24,400/mo at 95th percentile)

Redwood capabilities re: data masking
- Yes — token-level redaction is supported in VPC deployments via our ingest preprocessor. We provide masking rules and an option to keep only hashed identifiers in logs (we will not store raw PII). Full details are in Redwood_POCTechSpec.pdf.

Next steps I’ll take this version of the MAP into a shared sheet and request owners to accept tasks. Can everybody confirm the named owners above and procurement’s required SOW template? If all good, we’ll lock kickoff for 11/8 and schedule a 30-min technical kickoff with your infra team.

Attachments: Hummingbird_MAP_v1.xlsx (updated), Redwood_POCTechSpec.pdf

— Priya
Priya Natarajan | Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
priya@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

Subject: Re: Hummingbird PoC: timeline, stakeholders & compliance MAP (ack)

Priya / Ellen —

This looks good and covers the items I care about. A few quick notes:
- Confirmed: Jamal will own SOC2 artifact review and will loop in Talia if we need infra-level logs.
- We need the specific log retention config for the pilot (suggested: 90 days masked, 365 days aggregate telemetry). Please include that in the ops runbook.
- Procurement: please include the draft SOW in the MAP for procurement to review by 11/29.

I’m happy to kick off a 30-min security sync on 2026-11-09 (10am PT) to review the SOC2 artifact set and retention. Ellen — please confirm if that slot works.

Thanks,
Jamal Ortiz
Head of Security, Hummingbird AI
jamal.ortiz@hummingbird.ai | +1 (415) 555-3322
